# Peak Leads

> Peak Leads is a small South African team that builds websites, SEO and exclusive lead systems for home service businesses.

Web design, SEO and lead generation for South African trades: roofers, plumbers, electricians, solar and aircon installers, borehole and water specialists and builders. You work with the people who do the work, not an account manager who forwards your email. To get in touch, use the [contact page](https://peakleads.agency/contact/).

## Services

- [What we do](https://peakleads.agency/services/): Web design, SEO, AI SEO, Google and Meta ads, and exclusive lead generation for South African service businesses. Start with one or stack them.
- [Web design](https://peakleads.agency/web-design/): Websites for South African trades and service businesses: fast, readable on a phone, and written so a visitor picks up the phone instead of leaving. The finished site is yours outright, and technical SEO is in place from the day it goes live.
- [SEO](https://peakleads.agency/seo/): Local SEO for South African businesses, done properly: Google Business Profile work, fixes for the technical issues holding a site back, and service and location pages for the towns you actually work.
- [AI SEO](https://peakleads.agency/ai-seo/): Getting a business named when Google AI Mode, AI Overviews or ChatGPT write the answer instead of listing links, by structuring pages so a machine can lift a clean answer out of them.
- [Google Ads and Meta ads](https://peakleads.agency/google-ads/): Google Ads and Meta ads management for South African service businesses: campaigns, landing pages and tracking from the click through to the booked call.
- [Exclusive lead generation](https://peakleads.agency/lead-generation/): Enquiries generated under your own brand, verified before they reach you and sent to you alone. No shared lists.

## Company

- [Home](https://peakleads.agency/): Web design, SEO and lead generation for South African trades, from one small team rather than a rotating cast of account managers.
- [About](https://peakleads.agency/about/): Meet the Peak Leads team: the founder, developers, SEO specialist and operations manager who build websites, SEO and exclusive lead systems for home service contractors.
- [Pricing](https://peakleads.agency/pricing/): Lead generation packages for South Africa and the US: appointment setting, email outreach and LinkedIn ads.
- [Contact](https://peakleads.agency/contact/): Email, book a call or send a quick message.
- [Free audit](https://peakleads.agency/free-audit/): Quick questions about your business. We review your answers and reply with what we would do, what it costs, and whether we are the right fit.

## Blog

- [Insights for the trades](https://peakleads.agency/blog/): Straight answers on marketing for home service businesses. Useful whether you hire us or not.
- [What do roofing leads cost in South Africa?](https://peakleads.agency/blog/how-much-do-roofing-leads-cost/): What roofing leads cost in South Africa depends on exclusivity, freshness and speed. Compare vendors on cost per booked job, not on the price per lead.
- [Exclusive vs shared leads in South Africa](https://peakleads.agency/blog/exclusive-vs-shared-leads/): A shared lead is sold to several contractors at once. An exclusive lead goes to you alone. How to work out which one costs your business less per booked job.
- [Google Ads vs Facebook ads for South African trades](https://peakleads.agency/blog/google-ads-vs-facebook-ads-for-contractors/): Google Ads catches South Africans already searching for your trade. Meta ads fill the quiet weeks. What moves each cost, and which one to run first.
- [Do you still need a website if you have a Google Business Profile?](https://peakleads.agency/blog/google-business-profile-vs-website/): Do you need a website if you have a Google Business Profile? For most South African trades, yes. What the profile does well and where it stops.
- [Who owns your website? The domain, hosting and logins to get in writing](https://peakleads.agency/blog/who-owns-your-website/): Who owns your website? The domain, hosting, files, words and Google accounts can each be in someone else's name. How to check, and what to get in writing.
- [How many pages does a small business website need?](https://peakleads.agency/blog/how-many-pages-does-a-website-need/): How many pages does a small business website need? A page per service and area you work, plus the basics, and when a one-page site is enough for a trade.
- [Will my new website show up on Google?](https://peakleads.agency/blog/new-website-not-showing-on-google/): Will my new website show up on Google? For your name, usually. For your trade and suburb, it takes more. What Google needs first, and how to check.
- [Why is my old website still showing on Google?](https://peakleads.agency/blog/old-website-still-on-google/): Old website still showing on Google after a redesign? Why it happens, how to redirect old pages properly and what to do if your domain changed too.
- [SEO or Google Ads first? How South African trades should choose](https://peakleads.agency/blog/seo-or-google-ads-first/): SEO or Google Ads first? It depends on your diary, your website, the kind of work you do and what a job pays. How South African trades should choose.
